name: app-conversational-onboarding-with-sunset-arc-gradient
title: Question screen with pale blue background and a blurred sunset arc at the bottom
whatItIs: A single phone with a lavender-blue screen, a slim progress indicator with '02', a small intro line and a larger question in navy, and a blurred blue, orange and cream arc rising from the bottom behind two pill buttons: a white 'Write' and a blue voice button, plus a Skip link.
whatItMeans: Warm and human; the glowing arc feels like a friendly presence asking the question.
techniques: Use a blurred multi-colour arc as an ambient AI visual.
Put a small intro line above a large question.
Offer two answer modes (write or speak) as pills.
Use tiny dot progress with a bold current segment.

vocabulary.definition: A soft colour glow used as decoration.
Two buttons offering different ways to answer.
